verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents Summy AI's applicant overview, which summarizes an applicant's current status and rejection reasons and suggests next steps for the review. It also documents AI-powered Anomaly Detection that flags anomalies in transaction data, so in-product AI insights and suggestions are clearly present. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, deeper documentation of how the insights are produced and surfaced, and evidence of AI insights across aggregate or portfolio-level data beyond single-applicant summaries and transaction anomalies.
